connect.featureTeam: Team roles, workspaces, and SSO on Scale
connect.zohoRegionHint: Find this in Zoho → Settings → Mail Accounts if you are unsure.
connect.usernamePlaceholder: Leave blank to use your email address
connect.usernameHint: Only needed if your provider uses a separate login username instead of your email address. Check your provider's mail settings (e.g. "Username" or "Account name").
connect.passwordHint: Use your mailbox password. If your provider has 2-step verification (e.g. Gmail, Outlook, iCloud), generate an app password instead. The credential is encrypted before storage.
connect.discardBody: You've entered details that haven't been saved yet. If you close now, they'll be lost.
connect.imapLeadBody: IMAP and SMTP connect straight to your mail server, with no third-party consent screen in the way. Use this for a work mailbox, a custom domain, or any provider not listed here.
connect.googleStepsIntro: Google shows a caution screen before it hands access to any app it has not reviewed. Here is what you will see and how to get through it.
connect.googleConsentAlt: You will see this icon on Google’s screen, next to the mcpemails.com name.
connect.googleStep1: Pick your Google account and check the access you are granting.
connect.googleStep2: On the screen headed “Google hasn’t verified this app”, choose Advanced.
connect.googleStepsWhy: “Unsafe” is Google’s standard wording for a developer it has not reviewed. It is not a finding about this app. Google’s review requires a paid third-party security assessment we have chosen not to buy.
connect.googleStepsDuration: Once connected, the inbox stays connected. Access renews automatically in the background and stops only if you revoke it from your Google account.
connect.hintGeneric: Works with any mailbox that speaks IMAP and SMTP.
connect.hintIcloud: iCloud needs two-factor authentication and an app-specific password. Your Apple Account password will be rejected.
connect.hintYahoo: Yahoo needs a generated app password. Your normal Yahoo password will be rejected. Turn on two-step verification first, then create the app password.
connect.hintZoho: Turn on IMAP access in Zoho first — Settings → Mail Accounts → IMAP Access is off by default. With two-factor on, also generate an application-specific password.
connect.hintYandex: In Yandex Mail → Settings, enable IMAP and turn on app passwords and OAuth tokens. Both are required. Then generate an app password in Yandex ID.
connect.hintFastmail: Fastmail connects with a generated app password. Your normal Fastmail password will be rejected.
connect.zohoAccountTypeHint: Paid accounts on a custom domain use Zoho’s organization (imappro) servers.
connect.yandexAccountTypeHint: Personal accounts normally use the name before @. Business accounts use the full email address.
connect.yandexLoginHint: Optional manual override for unusual account configurations.
connect.securityPortNote: Changing this sets the matching standard port.
connect.appPasswordHint: An app password generated by {provider}, not your normal account password. It is encrypted before storage.
